parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description: The number of tasks to display per page.

parameters.name: ResourceIds
parameters.description: The resource ID to which the task belongs, such as a site ID. You can obtain the site ID by calling the [ListSites](~~ListSites~~) operation.

parameters.name: TaskStatus
parameters.description:
The current status of the task. Valid values:

- in_progress: in progress.
- success: completed.
- fail: failed.

parameters.name: TaskType
parameters.description: The task type. For example, the task type for applying for a free certificate is free_cert.
